info.title: WuKongIM Product HTTP Runtime API
info.description: Complete source-aligned contract for the 41 Product HTTP operations registered by the current runtime. These routes have no built-in authentication.

zh.title: WuKongIM Product HTTP 运行时 API
zh.description: 与当前运行时注册的 41 个 Product HTTP 操作对齐的完整合同；这些路由没有内建鉴权。
本地单节点集群示例

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User device metadata, presence, and system identities.

zh.description: 用户设备元数据、在线状态与系统身份。
已配置的客户端 Gateway 地址。

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Message recovery, events, and command-message compatibility.

zh.description: 消息恢复、事件与命令消息兼容接口。
受信后端消息提交。
Channel 元数据与成员列表管理。
会话同步与用户侧状态。

get.description: Returns the configured public or intranet addresses; node aliases are checked in node_id, nodeId, nodeID order.

zh.description: 返回已配置的公网或内网地址；节点别名按 node_id、nodeId、nodeID 顺序读取。

post.summary: Resolve one address group for UIDs
post.description: Echoes an unbounded UID array inside the selected address group; retained for compatibility.

zh.summary: 批量解析 UID 地址组
zh.description: 在所选地址组中回显无上限 UID 数组；该接口仅为兼容保留。

post.summary: Create or update a device token
post.description: Upserts one UID/device token; default Gateway authentication requires later CONNECT credentials for the same UID and device category to match it.

zh.description: 创建缺失的 UID 元数据并更新一个设备 Token；Gateway Token 鉴权默认启用，后续相同 UID 与设备类别的 CONNECT 凭据必须与它匹配。

post.description: Clears one stored device token and schedules owner-local Session closure; device_flag -1 selects APP, Web, and PC.

zh.description: 清空一个已存设备 Token 并调度 owner-local Session 关闭；device_flag=-1 选择 APP、Web 与 PC。

post.description: Returns one row per active authority route; an empty UID array returns the legacy status object instead of an array.

zh.description: 每条活跃权威路由返回一行；空 UID 数组返回旧式 status 对象而不是数组。

post.description: Persists system identities and adds them to the current process cache.

zh.description: 持久化系统身份并加入当前进程缓存。

post.description: Removes persisted system identities and current-process cache entries.

zh.description: 移除持久化系统身份与当前进程缓存项。

get.description: Aggregates the complete persisted system UID set into one unbounded response.

zh.description: 把完整持久化系统 UID 集合聚合为一个无界响应。

post.summary: Add node-local system UID cache entries
post.description: Mutates only the current process cache and does not persist or replicate the change.

zh.summary: 添加节点本地系统 UID 缓存
zh.description: 只修改当前进程缓存，不持久化也不复制该变更。

post.summary: Remove node-local system UID cache entries
post.description: Mutates only the current process cache and does not change durable system identities.

zh.summary: 移除节点本地系统 UID 缓存
zh.description: 只修改当前进程缓存，不改变持久化系统身份。

post.description: Upserts all metadata flags and optionally resets subscribers; disband is terminal.

zh.summary: 创建或更新 Channel 元数据
zh.description: 全量更新元数据标志并可重置订阅者；disband 为终态。

post.description: Passes the zero-valued full record to UpdateInfo when fields are omitted; retained for compatibility.

zh.description: 字段省略时仍把零值完整记录交给 UpdateInfo；该接口仅为兼容保留。

post.description: Sets the durable disband flag without deleting Channel identity; request-key validation is weak.

zh.description: 设置持久化 disband 标志但不删除 Channel 身份；请求 Key 校验较弱。

post.description: Adds non-blank subscribers; channel_type 0 becomes group type 2 and reset=1 replaces the snapshot.

zh.summary: 添加或替换持久订阅者
zh.description: 添加非空白订阅者；channel_type=0 转为群组类型 2，reset=1 替换快照。

post.description: Removes non-blank subscribers; unlike subscriber_add, channel_type 0 is not normalized.

zh.description: 移除非空白订阅者；与 subscriber_add 不同，channel_type=0 不会被归一化。

post.description: Clears ordinary subscribers through bounded internal pages; person Channels are rejected.

zh.description: 通过内部有界分页清空普通订阅者；个人 Channel 会被拒绝。

post.description: Replaces the derived Type-8 temporary subscriber list; UID elements are not validated by the entry adapter.

zh.summary: 替换临时 Channel 订阅者
zh.description: 替换派生 Type-8 临时订阅者列表；入口适配器不校验 UID 元素。

post.description: Adds the supplied UID strings to the derived Channel denylist.

zh.summary: 添加 Channel 拒绝列表成员
zh.description: 把给定 UID 字符串加入派生 Channel 拒绝列表。

post.description: Removes the old list before adding the supplied values; only channel_id is validated at entry.

zh.summary: 替换 Channel 拒绝列表
zh.description: 先移除旧列表再添加给定值；入口只校验 channel_id。

post.description: Removes the supplied UID strings from the derived Channel denylist.

zh.summary: 移除 Channel 拒绝列表成员
zh.description: 从派生 Channel 拒绝列表移除给定 UID 字符串。

post.description: Clears the derived denylist through bounded internal traversal.

zh.summary: 移除全部 Channel 拒绝列表成员
zh.description: 通过内部有界遍历清空派生拒绝列表。

post.description: Adds non-blank UIDs to the derived Channel allowlist.

zh.summary: 添加 Channel 允许列表成员
zh.description: 把非空白 UID 加入派生 Channel 允许列表。

post.description: Removes the old list before adding supplied values; only channel_id is validated at entry.

zh.summary: 替换 Channel 允许列表
zh.description: 先移除旧列表再添加给定值；入口只校验 channel_id。

post.description: Removes non-blank UIDs from the derived Channel allowlist.

zh.summary: 移除 Channel 允许列表成员
zh.description: 从派生 Channel 允许列表移除非空白 UID。

post.description: Clears the derived allowlist through bounded internal traversal.

zh.summary: 移除全部 Channel 允许列表成员
zh.description: 通过内部有界遍历清空派生允许列表。

get.description: Returns an unbounded full list; missing or invalid channel_type is silently treated as 0.

zh.summary: 列出全部 Channel 允许列表成员
zh.description: 返回无界完整列表；channel_type 缺失或无效时会静默视为 0。

post.description: Accepts the complete compatibility parser, including legacy aliases, transient flags, and request-scoped subscribers; inspect reason on HTTP 200.

zh.description: 接受完整兼容 parser，包括旧别名、瞬时标志与请求级订阅者；HTTP 200 时仍需检查 reason。

post.description: Validates and applies one message-scoped event projection; non-null headers are unsupported.

zh.description: 校验并应用一次消息级事件投影；不支持非 null headers。

post.description: Returns the latest durable CMD generation; message_seq is accepted but ignored.

zh.description: 返回最新持久 CMD generation；message_seq 仅兼容接收但会被忽略。

post.description: Requires a positive last_message_seq but acknowledges the server's latest recorded generation, not that supplied value.

zh.summary: 确认最新命令消息同步
zh.description: 要求 last_message_seq 为正数，但确认的是服务端最近记录的 generation，而不是该输入值。

post.description: Starts durable offline discovery after the current command-channel tail.

zh.summary: 绑定命令 Channel 发现
zh.description: 从当前命令 Channel tail 之后开始持久离线发现。

post.description: Tombstones durable discovery without deleting command messages.

zh.summary: 解绑命令 Channel 发现
zh.description: 为持久发现写入 tombstone，但不删除命令消息。

post.description: Checks membership visibility and returns an ascending page; limit is 100 by default and capped at 10000.

zh.summary: 同步一个 Channel 的已提交消息
zh.description: 校验成员可见性并返回升序分页；limit 默认 100，最大 10000。

post.description: Validates all memberships before one aligned batch read; item failures are embedded in the HTTP-200 response.

zh.description: 批量读取前校验全部成员关系；单项失败嵌入 HTTP 200 响应。

post.description: Returns one bounded membership page; only done=true completes the pass.

zh.description: 返回一页有界 membership；只有 done=true 才表示本轮完成。

post.description: Rehydrates up to 200 keys without rewinding completed coverage; duplicate keys are merged.

zh.description: 重新 hydrate 最多 200 个 Key，不回退已完成 coverage；重复 Key 会合并。

post.description: Parses delimited per-Channel cursors and returns the old bare array without a completion signal.

zh.description: 解析分隔式逐 Channel 游标并返回没有完成标记的旧式裸数组。

post.description: Advances read_seq to the current committed head; unknown legacy fields such as message_seq are ignored.

zh.description: 把 read_seq 推进到当前已提交 head；message_seq 等未知旧字段会被忽略。

post.description: Monotonically advances read_seq so no more than unread messages remain.

zh.description: 单调推进 read_seq，使剩余未读消息不超过 unread。

post.summary: Hide Conversation through the current head
post.description: Advances deleted_to_seq to the current committed head without deleting Channel membership.

zh.summary: 把会话隐藏到当前 head
zh.description: 把 deleted_to_seq 推进到当前已提交 head，但不删除 Channel 成员关系。

post.description: Records an explicit open, switch, or resume action for ordering; message paths do not activate it.

zh.description: 记录显式打开、切换或恢复动作以参与排序；消息路径不会隐式激活。

NodeIDSnake.name: node_id
NodeIDSnake.description: Preferred node selector. A specified value must be a configured positive uint64.

NodeIDCamel.name: nodeId
NodeIDCamel.description: Legacy alias read only when node_id is absent.

NodeIDUpperCamel.name: nodeID
NodeIDUpperCamel.description: Legacy alias read after node_id and nodeId.

Intranet.name: intranet
Intranet.description: Any parseable non-zero integer selects intranet addresses; invalid text behaves as 0.

ChannelIDQuery.name: channel_id
ChannelIDQuery.description: Unvalidated Channel ID used by the legacy full-list route.

ChannelTypeQuery.name: channel_type
ChannelTypeQuery.description: Parsed as uint8; missing or invalid text is silently treated as 0.

TraceID.name: X-WK-Trace-ID
TraceID.description: Optional 32-character hexadecimal trace ID. Invalid values are ignored and replaced with a generated ID.

CompatibilityBadRequest.description: Input, validation, dependency, or downstream error

OnlineStatusOK.description: Active routes or the empty-request status object

SendUnavailable.description: Retry-required routing failure or restore maintenance

msg.description: Human-readable and not stable for machine matching.

RouteBatchRequest.description: Unbounded by the current Product HTTP entry.

uid.description: The entry adapter does not validate this field.

device_flag.description: -1 selects APP, Web, and PC; other values are converted to uint8 by the use case.

OnlineStatusRequest.description: Unbounded by the current Product HTTP entry.

uids.description: May be empty or null; no entry-level element validation.

CompatibilityFlag.description: Exactly 1 means true; every other integer means false.

subscribers.description: May be null; elements are not validated at entry and a non-empty list is rejected for person Channels.

channel_type.description: 0 or omission becomes group type 2; type 1 is rejected.

temp_subscriber.description: Exactly 1 is rejected; other values are ignored.

channel_type.description: Type 1 is rejected; type 0 is passed through.

sender_uid.description: Used only when from_uid is empty; when both are empty, the configured message.system_uid is used.

client_msg_no.description: Optional; an empty value disables idempotency lookup.

subscribers.description: A non-empty array selects request-scoped delivery, requires an empty channel_id, and requires sync_once; null behaves as omission.

message_id.description: Positive values are converted to uint64; zero and negative values are omitted from the command.

event_key.description: Empty selects the default lane; stream.finish forces the finish lane.

headers.description: Only absent or null is accepted.

last_message_seq.description: Required by the entry but ignored by the use case.

limit.description: Values <=0 select 100; values above 10000 are capped.

pull_mode.description: 1 pulls newer messages; every other uint8 value follows the older-message branch.

include_event_meta.description: Any non-zero value requests event metadata.

login_uid.description: Accepted by JSON decoding but ignored; the top-level login_uid is used.

limit.description: Values <=0 select 100; values above 10000 are capped.

error.description: Raw item-scoped error text; omitted on success.

last_msg_seqs.description: Legacy channel_id:channel_type:message_seq entries separated by |; malformed entries are skipped.

msg_count.description: Values <=0 return an empty array; downstream sync caps positive values at 10000.

page_size.description: When page>0, values <=0 become 100 and values above 500 are capped.
